title: Experimenting with input formats and writing styles

videos.script: Change two things at once, and a number can only tell you that something changed. {{title}} Here is the triage prompt written two ways. One lists its fields as bullets. The other says the same things in a paragraph. {{diff}} Run both on seventy messages and the paragraph wins, forty-eight to forty-six. {{check}} Look closer. Not one category changed. The two messages that moved lost a code fence, and the fences moved because the wording moved. {{fences}} The sign test said so first. Two changed messages can never be evidence. You need six, all going the same way, before the test calls a difference unlikely to be chance. {{sign}} Now run the paragraph again with a temperature left in the command. Fourteen messages break, and the test is sure something changed. It cannot tell you what. {{confound}} By the end of this lesson you can design an experiment that changes one thing, report what it found even when it found nothing, and choose the format of the data you put in a prompt. {{close}}
